offer.text: My parent's taken ill and my own remedies aren't helping. A golden carrot, pressed into their hand by someone who cares — would you tend to them for me? I can't bear to see them suffer.

accept.text: Bless you. Be gentle — they're prouder than they are strong, these days.

decline.text: Please reconsider. They haven't many seasons left to waste on stubbornness.

in_progress.text: Have you tended my parent yet? How do they fare?

ready.text: The color's back in their cheeks? Oh, thank the light.

complete.text: You gave my parent ease when I couldn't. There's one last thing I'd ask — but it can wait until they've rested.
